title: A real grandson asking for $50 for a birthday cake
description: Based on our real-call test: the user's grandson calls from his own number, at the bakery picking up Mom's birthday cake and a little short. He asks for $50, with no rush and no secrets. Low risk: the payment waits for the call to end, then goes through.

lines.text: Hi Grandma, it's Jake. Happy Sunday! How are you doing?
I'm at the bakery right now, picking up Mom's birthday cake for tonight.
It costs a bit more than I thought and I'm a little short.
So can you please send me $50? No rush, $50 only. I'll pay you back at dinner.
Thanks, Grandma. Love you, see you tonight!
